answers.question: How long before I can run again? A friend wants me to race the Thanksgiving 10K in five weeks.
answers.answer: You can start next week with 5‑6 mile easy runs. The 10‑K in five weeks is doable if you keep training low now and avoid hard work. Gradually add about a mile each week after this recovery week, keeping paces comfortable.

new.analysis: After a marathon the athlete needs a low‑volume recovery week. The plan keeps volume at 5‑6 miles per easy run and eliminates any quality or long sessions. Rest days allow full recovery of the quads, calves, and overall fatigue. The 10‑K race in five weeks is realistic if the athlete stays gentle now, adds a short easy run a week, and only turns to threshold once the next recovery week is complete. Monitoring heart‑rate drift and pain will signal when to add mileage.
